title: Windows command resolution ignores the child environment's vetted PATH
reasoning: On Windows, _platform_command calls shutil.which before CommandRunner receives the supplied child environment. Resolution therefore uses the ambient PATH instead of the preflight-selected child PATH and can execute a different ClawPatch binary.
reproduction: Put different clawpatch.cmd files on the ambient PATH and env["PATH"], then call _run(["clawpatch"], env=env). The ambient executable is resolved.
recommendation: Pass the effective child PATH into _platform_command and call shutil.which with that explicit path.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests or Windows PATH-resolution assertions were supplied.
suggestedRegressionTest: Assert that Windows resolution selects clawpatch exclusively from env["PATH"], not os.environ["PATH"].
minimumFixScope: Update _run and _platform_command and add a Windows regression test.

history.reasoning: The original evidence remains. Current _run passes env["PATH"] into _platform_command, which supplies that path explicitly to shutil.which. Both focused Windows PATH-resolution regressions pass; the linked attempt’s failures were unrelated to this repair. ✅ Done — Windows child-PATH command resolution revalidated as fixed.
